newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates quoted steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates quoted steady to higher.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to higher levels on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- One barge, Hennepin, Illinois River, this week, no bid, offer 120 percent, up 10 percentage points from Tuesday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, Hennepin and north, next week, bid 105 percent of tariff, unchanged from Tuesday, no bid, unchanged.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of April 20 and April 27, bid 120 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Nine barges, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of June and July, bid 117-1/2 percent, unchanged from Tuesday, offered two barges each at 125 percent, unchanged.
- Nine barges, Illinois River, one each week of June and July, bid 105 percent, unchanged from Tuesday, offer 115 percent, unchanged.
